SaltWatch now follows **Home Assistant’s number-format preference** independently of the interface language.

- English menus with a comma-based number format show **25,40%**; a dot-based preference shows **25.40%**.
- Supports HA’s language, system, comma/dot, space/comma, Swiss, and no-grouping modes using the same locale mapping as HA’s frontend.
- The same formatting applies to salt level, forecast days, thresholds, accessible labels, and decimal-place examples in the native editor.
- Changing only the number-format preference refreshes the card and editor without requiring a sensor change or reload.
- The existing 0/1/2 decimal-place setting and whole percentages in combined view remain unchanged.

Includes regression tests for all number-format modes, live locale changes, editor examples, and browser rendering.
